title: Disclosure Schedules

origin.publisher: Omni Agent Solutions (claims agent), for the debtors in In re Finch Therapeutics Group, Inc., et al., Case No. 26-10409 (LSS) (Bankr. D. Del.)
origin.title: Disclosure Schedules to Asset Purchase Agreement (Finch Therapeutics sellers and Ferring Asset Holding LLC), attached to the Notice of Filing of Schedules to Asset Purchase Agreement, D.I. 296, filed July 24, 2026
origin.clearance_note: A public bankruptcy court filing (D.I. 296, filed July 24, 2026), posted on the case website of the court-appointed claims agent, Omni Agent Solutions (https://omniagentsolutions.com/FinchTherapeutics). Downloaded by script. The original is 66 pages: a 2-page court notice followed by the 64-page Disclosure Schedules (Execution Version). The court notice, which carries the debtors' attorneys' names, contact details, bar numbers and an /s/ signature, was dropped, as were pages 7-57 of the original, which continue the Schedule 1.1(e) patent table; this sample keeps the cover, the preamble, Schedule 1.1(b), the first page of the patent table, and every schedule from the trademarks onward. Schedule 1.1(b) names three individual contacts in its notice addresses; each was replaced with an obviously fake name. Every other party is an organization (the sellers, the purchaser, universities, a technology-transfer company and insurers) and was kept, as were the debtors' partial tax-ID digits, which are corporate. The court-stamped header still reads the original page numbers (Page N of 64). The PDF's hidden metadata was cleared. Verified by text search on the committed PDF and this folder: no original name survives.

redactions.note: The original values are deliberately NOT recorded here. Writing them beside their replacements would republish the personal data the redaction removed. The rules file used by redact.py stays outside the repo.

notes: The request named no fields or feature page in its keys; its notes suggested original page 59 (Schedule 1.2(c) Excluded Insurance Policies, page 6 of this sample) with the schedule title, the primary D&O insurer, policy number and policy term, and the automobile policy number, as suggestions only. Four of the five shipped. The primary D&O insurer was not featured: its value spans two lines of its cell and inspect_fields.py reads its range as OFF, as it does for seven other insurer and coverage cells on this page; every policy number and policy term reads ok. No substitute was added, so the overlay shows the one schedule, its primary D&O policy and the automobile policy. No person is featured. The page range was trimmed from 66 to 13 pages: the 2-page court notice and 51 pages of continuation of the patent table were dropped, as the request suggested.
